title: Thermal Work Limit (TWL) reference vectors -- Brake & Bates (2002) algorithm

units.twl: W/m2 (metabolic heat per m2 body surface)
units.sweat_rate: kg m-2 h-1 (and L/h for a 1.8 m2 person)

conventions.humidity: wet bulb is PSYCHROMETRIC (aspirated), not natural wet bulb; pa = psat(twb) - 0.000644*P*(tdb-twb)
conventions.mrt_from_globe: ISO 7726:1998 Annex B, max(natural, forced) convection, emissivity 0.95; default D = 0.15 m
conventions.root: scan down from tcore-1e-6 in 0.05 K steps to first tsk with H-loss >= 0, then bisect to 1e-10 K
conventions.no_root: if H-loss >= 0 already at tcore-1e-6 -> TWL = 0, flag NO_ROOT_NET_HEAT_GAIN
conventions.zones: ADOSH-SF TG v4.0 Table 1: HIGH if TWL<115; MEDIUM if 115<=TWL<140; LOW if TWL>=140 (sub-band >=220 'unrestricted' from B&B 2002)
conventions.backstops: B&B 2002 Table II / M&B 2007 Table 6: DB>44 C or WB>32 C -> withdrawal/restricted regardless of TWL (NOT in ADOSH v4.0 table)
conventions.display: compare unrounded TWL to thresholds; if displaying an integer use floor()
